Shared 'phonemic awareness' LC tags corroborate the domain link but are not themselves the basis for the judgment. judgment.rationale: First SFI: Grade R (rank 0), identity scope grade=grade r|term=term 3|skill area=emergent writing|sub strand=handwriting, 'Traces simple outlines of pictures, patterns and own names where the correct starting point and writing direction are indicated on letters'. Second SFI: Grade R, identity scope term=term 2, same Skill Area and Handwriting sub-strand, 'Copies patterns onto pegboards and copies patterns, words and letters onto paper'. Although the term scopes differ (Term 2 -> Term 3), the supplied Learning Component claims show both statements recurring across terms: the tracing statement carries a claim under the Term 2 Handwriting path (ancestors 83d99627 / bd46a3d7 TERM 2 / f98c1ea6 / 0753c0b3, source SFI e8e4ea32), and the 'Copies patterns onto pegboards' component carries a claim under the Term 3 path (83d99627 / f5f4d44a TERM 3 / e974dc46 / d3598905, source SFI c0944fb4). The term offset between these two nodes therefore records CAPS cross-term repetition rather than expanded capability, and tracing an outline with indicated starting point and direction is not evidently a more demanding successor to copying patterns, words and letters onto paper; so neither direction of buildsTowards is supported. The pair is more than shared wording or shared hierarchy, however: these are two distinct, complementary emergent-handwriting reproduction tasks within the same Grade R Handwriting sub-strand (guided tracing of outlines/own name with directionality conventions alongside free copying of patterns, words and letters onto pegboards and paper), which together reinforce fine-motor control and letter/pattern formation. That is substantive pair-specific coherence without dependency, so relatesTo (symmetric, null direction) is the correct judgment. Limitations: both endpoints' source evidence is truncated (24 omitted items each) and the first endpoint's LC evidence is truncated, and all endpoints and ancestors carry upstream audit/merge context warnings retained below.

This is more than shared wording ('visual') because the pairing links a reading-with-visuals comprehension behaviour to a speaking-with-visuals production behaviour within the same grade. It does not, however, support buildsTowards: the Term 4 skill's distinguishing demands — planning, structuring and delivering a sustained recount or description — are a different competency in a different strand rather than a deepening or extension of interpreting a graphical text, and the visual aid there supports delivery rather than being a text to be read.
